_comment: Where check_updates.py looks for the latest version of ASDR and each companion. Edit when you re-pin a companion in marketplace.json.

ui-ux-pro-max.pinned_note: Pinned by sha in the asdr marketplace. A newer upstream version means the ASDR maintainer should re-pin; users get it with the next asdr release.

mirofish.update_command: Maintainer: re-verify scripts/mirofish_validate.py against the new commit, then re-pin `commit` here. Users get it with the next ASDR release; `mirofish_stack.py purge --yes` then `up` switches an installed stack.
mirofish.pinned_note: Pinned by commit; ASDR builds this exact source with Docker. A newer upstream is not used until the maintainer re-pins.

mirofish-offline.update_command: Maintainer: re-verify scripts/mirofish_validate.py against the new commit, then re-pin `commit` here. Users get it with the next ASDR release; `mirofish_stack.py purge --yes` then `up` switches an installed stack.
mirofish-offline.pinned_note: Pinned by commit; ASDR builds this exact source with Docker. A newer upstream is not used until the maintainer re-pins.
